'''April 2000 Geneva tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Beyond Reality, Geneva, Illinois on 15 April 2000. [[Steve Kuperman]] won it. It is known from Steve Kuperman's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d555">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-18-geneva-illinois-4-15-2000d555/ geneva-illinois-4-15-2000], DeckTech (Steve "Crazy Hermit" Kuperman, 18 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-18-geneva-illinois-4-15-2000d555/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 15 April 2000
* '''Site:''' Beyond Reality, Geneva, Illinois
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 23
* '''Winner:''' [[Steve Kuperman]]
